name: 27925-decodeheavy-12b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process engine, one GPU, one node
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, bounded at 160 requests, warmup the first 15% by completion, 3600 s safety cap
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompt exactly 128 tokens and output exactly 1024 (min = max on both), greedy at temperature 0.0, request_format plain
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant generating 1024-token drafts from short prompts for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The whole engine command line. Nothing here is tuned; every key not written is left at the
# pinned engine's own default.
model: mistralai/Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407

# The vendor's tokenizer (mistral-common, from the checkpoint's own `tekken.json`) rather than
# the HF conversion. DECLARED, NOT TUNABLE: it is part of what this setup is.
tokenizer-mode: mistral

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The workload's worst case is 128 + 1024 tokens; the checkpoint's own window is 131072.
max-model-len: 8192
